one_line: Show the finished bookmark in use first, under a POV line that names the parent's stage.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down on a wooden table: a watercolour palette, scissors, a book; 0:01 a hand slides a finished planet bookmark into a children's book. Text: "פוב: הבן שלך הגיע לגיל שהוא צריך סימנייה לספרים שלו 🥹". No speech.
q1_hook.why: A POV line names a stage a parent recognises, over the finished result (T3, H2), with cuts from 0:00 (E1). But it is text and music only, so a viewer with sound on hears nothing that carries the hook (H6).

beats.what: POV text over the finished bookmark in a children's book, a child's hand on the page
beats.why: Result first, so the steps have a goal

beats.what: A brush wets the watercolour pans; small line "אני משתמשת בצבעי המים המעולים של גיאוטו"
beats.why: Step one and the brand, briefly

beats.what: A child cuts a strip from a painted sheet; "הוא ממש לא צריך להיות מדויק"
beats.why: A reassurance line makes it feel doable

beats.what: The child paints a free pattern; an adult paints a pink, purple and yellow strip
beats.why: The colourful middle, a new look each cut

beats.what: A glue stick adds a back layer; a flower punch; "(אפשר פשוט לניילן לרציניים שבינינו)"
beats.why: A light joke inside a step

beats.what: Planet foam stickers on the table; the child sticks them on
The bookmark in a book; "שהכנו בקלות ובכוחות עצמנו 💪", "בואו לתיאור ⬇️"
beats.why: The result in use, then a pointer to the caption

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen at the end, "בואו לתיאור ⬇️". Caption's last line before the partner tag: "תכינו סימניה ותספרו לי איך היה?".
q2_flow.why: A new picture about every 1.2 s keeps the middle moving (R3). The bookmark in a book at the end echoes the first frame, a natural loop (R4). 32 s suits a short craft (R2). The caption asks a concrete, personal question about doing the craft (R6).

q3_cta.what: On screen 0:30 to 0:32: "בואו לתיאור ⬇️" (read the caption). Caption, last line before the tag: "אז… תכינו סימניה ותספרו לי איך היה? 🤍📚✨". Nothing spoken, no link or code.
q3_cta.why: The caption ends on an open question a parent can answer from doing the craft (C5). But the on-screen pointer sits low, over the book, and sends viewers to a 150-word caption (C6). Two linked asks, read then make and tell, are close to one action (C1).

q4_shown.what: The finished bookmark in a children's book at 0:00; a watercolour tray wetted at 0:04; a child's hands and an adult's cutting, painting, gluing; planet stickers; the bookmark in a book at the end. Giotto in one small text line. No face, no price.
q4_shown.why: The palette is in frame at 0:00 and the brush is used at 0:04, close to the 2 s mark (S1). Hands only carry it (S4), and the child shows no face (S5). The brand is named once in small text, a light touch (H3).

q5_edit.what: 27 shots in 31.6 s, about 1.2 s each; straight cuts, quick in the first 4 s and after 0:18, one 6 s shot (0:06 to 0:12). No speech, no speed changes seen. Step text changes per beat. Ends on the bookmark in a book.
q5_edit.why: Cuts from 0.6 s open with motion (E1). The pace is quicker than the 2 to 5 s guide but stays in one scene (E2). With no speech, text carries every step (E4). It ends on the result, with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A watercolour bookmark a child makes, tied in the caption to the stage when a child follows a long story over days; serves a parent who reads with a child.
q6_topic.why: A named stage and a bedtime-reading moment are relatable (K6). The developmental meaning is wrapped in a personal story, not a claim (K4). The mood is warm, not high arousal (K1). A craft with a gentle story is easy to send to another parent (R5).

q7_filmed.what: Phone looking down at a round wooden table in daylight, hands only: an adult's with rings and a young child's. Close-ups of the palette and strips, a wider view of the planet stickers, and an open book. Handheld, slight movement.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands put the viewer in the maker's seat (F5), and the paint and strips fill the frame (F4). All live motion (F8), homemade but sharp and warmly lit (F7).

q8_text.on_screen: White text with a dark outline, no box, centred. 0:00 "פוב: הבן שלך הגיע לגיל שהוא צריך סימנייה לספרים שלו 🥹" (mid-frame). Step lines low, about 70 to 77% down: "מתחילים בהרטבת צבעי המים שלנו" (0:04), "וגוזרים מלבן ברוחב הדף" (0:06), "ומתחילים לצייר באופן חופשי" (0:12), "בואו לתיאור ⬇️" (0:30).
q8_text.caption: "מהרגע שאת הופכת למטפלת באמנות,". About 150 words: a poetic personal story of what a bookmark means, a closing question, last line "בשיתוף @giotto_israel". No hashtags, no search keywords.
q8_text.why: A POV headline at 0:00 states the topic (T3). Step lines in the lower band, one shown only about 1 s, are short for their length (T5, T4). The caption opens with a reflective line, not keywords, and has no hashtags (T7). The partner line is last, under "more" (T8).

weak_points: No voice, so the value and the ask sit in a long caption; step lines in the lower band, some shown only 1 s; no hashtags; the partner line is last; the brand text is small.
lumebook_takeaway: Open on the finished object with a POV text line naming the parent's stage, then top-down hands only, ending on it in use.
not_verified: Music (transcript only "תודה רבה", no speech evident). The child's age. No corrections to the coded file, which matched the frames.
